title: Toddler Playing with Teddy Bear by TV, 1960s Living Room B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white deckled-edge snapshot capturing a young child or toddler seated on a carpeted living room floor next to a seated teddy bear and a small bowl, having an imaginative playtime picnic. A large console television set is visible in the foreground on the left, while mid-century furnishings and bright daylight highlight the background.
